violation_type.title: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished (26 TAC §747.4303(c))
violation_type.short_title: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished
violation_type.typical_finding: Three out of the twelve children did not have a cot or matt to sleep on.  Three children were sleeping on beds.
